tapctl.exe
==========

ProxyGridVPN uses tapctl.exe from the OpenVPN project to create and remove its TAP-Windows6
network adapter ("proxygrid-tap0").

  Copyright (C) 2002-2026 OpenVPN Inc <sales@openvpn.net>
  Copyright (C) 2018-2026 Simon Rozman <simon@rozman.si>

tapctl is free software licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2. The full
license text is in COPYRIGHT.GPL next to this file. tapctl is a separate program that
ProxyGridVPN runs during installation and uninstallation; it is not linked into ProxyGridVPN.

Corresponding source code
-------------------------
tapctl.exe is built, unmodified, from OpenVPN release v2.7.9
(commit 7b60c2aa34992639691e3a2d651fe27301e2e9d5), directory src/tapctl:

  https://github.com/OpenVPN/openvpn/tree/7b60c2aa34992639691e3a2d651fe27301e2e9d5/src/tapctl

The build script, including the three configuration values it supplies, is
client/electron/windows/tapctl/build_tapctl.ps1 in
https://github.com/proxygridx/proxygridvpn-client. On request we will also provide the
complete corresponding source code for at least three years from each release; contact
contact@proxygrid.net.

TAP-Windows6 driver
-------------------
The TAP-Windows6 driver files (tap0901.sys, tap0901.cat, OemVista.inf) are from the OpenVPN
tap-windows6 project, version 9.27.0, available under the GNU General Public License
version 2 (COPYRIGHT.GPL) or, for the files noted in LICENSE, the MIT license (COPYRIGHT.MIT):

  https://github.com/OpenVPN/tap-windows6
